mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FURLMS.TB_LMS_CLAS_SCHDL ( CLAS_SCHDL_ID, SMSTR_CHRT_ID, SBJCT_ID, CLAS_SCHDL_TTL, CLAS_SCHDL_SDTTM, CLAS_SCHDL_EDTTM, CLAS_SCHDL_EXPLN, RGTR_ID, REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{clasSchdlId}, #{smstrChrtId}, #{sbjctId}, #{clasSchdlTtl}, #{clasSchdlSdttm}, #{clasSchdlEdttm}, #{clasSchdlExpln}, #{rgtrId}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') )
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : calendarDAO.orgTaskSchdlSelect 설 명 : 기관업무일정조회 */ SELECT A.TASK_SCHDL_ID , A.ORG_ID , A.TASK_SCHDL_TYCD , A.TASK_SDTTM , A.TASK_EDTTM , A.TASK_EXPLN , CASE WHEN FN_DTTM() BETWEEN A.TASK_SDTTM AND A.TASK_EDTTM THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS TASK_PERIOD_YN FROM TB_LMS_ORG_TASK_SCHDL A WHERE 1=1 AND A.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND A.TASK_SCHDL_TYCD = #{taskSchdlTycd}

/* SQL ID : calendarDAO.listPaging 설 명 : 수업일정 페이징 조회 */
SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(order by SYSJOB_SCHDL_SYMD, SYSJOB_SCHDL_EYMD) AS LINE_NO , ACAD_SCH_SN AS scheduleId , NVL(UNIV_CD, 'A') AS UNIV_CD , ACAD_SCH_NM AS TTL , SCH_CNTS AS content , SYSJOB_SCHDL_SYMD AS startDt , SYSJOB_SCHDL_EYMD AS endDt , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT FROM TB_HOME_ACAD_SCH WHERE SYSJOB_SCHDL_TYCD = 'course' AND USEYN = 'Y'
AND ( SUBSTR(SYSJOB_SCHDL_SYMD, 1, 4) = #{creYear} OR SUBSTR(SYSJOB_SCHDL_EYMD, 1, 4) = #{creYear} )
AND UNIV_CD <> 'G'
AND UNIV_CD <> 'C'
AND LOWER(ACAD_SCH_NM) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{searchValue}), '%')
ORDER BY SYSJOB_SCHDL_SYMD, SYSJOB_SCHDL_EYMD ) A WHERE A.LINE_NO >= #{firstIndex} AND A.LINE_NO <= #{listScale}
